correctness.rationale: The equilibrium coordinates and linear drift follow by direct differentiation. Ito moment closure produces the 3x3 matrix K and an exactly cross-checked cubic. Necessity uses mean drift stability plus the positive-definite solution of the stochastic Lyapunov identity; its diagonal and off-diagonal entries force delta>0 and Q(2bd+z delta)<2bd delta. Sufficiency constructs a positive-definite H from any eta in the exact open interval and obtains a strictly negative diagonal generator. Boundary equalities are excluded by the same strict necessity. The extracted symbolic checker verifies all algebraic coefficients; 1260 finite numerical cases independently stress-test but do not replace proof.

evidence: Buckwar–Kelly Sections 3.2–3.3 give the general 4x4 mean-square matrix and examine a distinct Holling-II response numerically; it is broad methodology, not an explicit analytic inequality.

Senosiain–Tocino analyze upper-triangular Jordan-type drift and structured noise matrices; the drift considered here has both signed nonzero off-diagonal couplings and a zero bottom-right diagonal entry.
The resulting constructive Lyapunov proof fixes both the entire noise trade-off and its boundary, not merely sufficient control of a moment-matrix eigenvalue.

originality.rationale: The claimed contribution is the exact algebraic two-independent-noise if-and-only-if region and universal strict predator-versus-prey critical variance ordering in the 2022 square-root predator–prey model. The motivating full article reports a Kronecker matrix and numerical graphs, while the broad 2014 method and a 2023 explicit survey do not print this frontier or its ordering. The general moment/Lyapunov criterion is prior art and is explicitly acknowledged, leaving an application-specific exact parameter-elimination result rather than an invented general theory.
residual_risks: The 2020 Tocino–Senosiain article was not read in full; source-specific content not exhaustively ruled out, though the accessible later survey describes different Jordan-type systems.

An unindexed exact specialization of the generic 2014 Lyapunov criterion may exist. The current novelty claim is limited to the explicit square-root model joint-variance boundary, not covariance methods in general.

value.rationale: The motivating 2022 ecological question asks how separate prey and predator environmental noise intensities affect coexistence. A complete joint-noise threshold replaces a sampled numerical region with a sharp strict parameter boundary, quantifies all prey/predator trade-offs, and proves the mathematically motivated observed asymmetry uniformly across the entire deterministic stability interval. The exact frontier permits reproducible boundary and interior decisions and identifies the critical noise strengths rather than offering an arbitrary parameter slice, minor numerical improvement, or simple normalization.
